safety_exclusions.house_8: Not mapped in Jyotisha or Western (longevity/death topics are out of scope). No remapping elsewhere.
safety_exclusions.D7: Projected only as prominence/routine emphasis; no medical claims are generated.
safety_exclusions.D6: Projected as 'creation/output'; no fertility or pregnancy claims are generated.

jyotisha.prominence: points = occupants + 0.5 x (planets casting graha drishti on the house); >=2 high, >=1 medium, else low

western.prominence: points = occupants (7 traditional planets) + 0.5 per Lot (Fortune/Spirit) in the house; >=2 high, >=1 medium, else low

ziwei.empty_palace: No projection (silence is not agreement or negativity). No star borrowing in primary track.
ziwei.prominence: points = major stars + birth mutagens on major stars; >=2 high, 1 medium, 0 none
ziwei.confidence: medium if the domain label is identical under the alternative leap-month school; otherwise low

bazi.polarity: favorable element under UG-A -> supportive; unfavorable -> challenging
bazi.confidence: medium when UG-B agrees with UG-A's verdict for the element; low when UG-B is silent; mixed/low on disagreement

cluster_rules.sinic: BaZi and Zi Wei combine internally (counted once). Only components with confidence >= medium are used; if they disagree in polarity the Sinic label is 'mixed'.
cluster_rules.speaks: A cluster speaks on a domain when its projection has confidence >= medium AND (prominence >= medium OR polarity != mixed).

grades.MODERATE: 2 speaking clusters share one polarity, no supportive-vs-challenging conflict
grades.WEAK: only one cluster speaks, or speakers share no polarity without conflict
grades.DIVERGENT: speaking clusters include both supportive and challenging

timing.jyotisha: JY-T1: domains of houses owned and occupied by the current Vimshottari antardasha lord
timing.western: WE-T1: domain of the profected house + domain of the house the lord of the year occupies natally
timing.sinic: SN-T1: domains of the BaZi annual stem's Ten God (BZ-T1 mapping) + domain of the Zi Wei yearly palace when identical under both leap-month schools
timing.window: moderate = 2 clusters activate same domain; strong = 3

T1.jyotisha: Sun in kendra or Sun exalted/own/moolatrikona
T1.sinic: 紫微/太阳/天府 in Ming palace (both leap schools) OR Officer/Seven Killings as a visible stem

T2.jyotisha: Mars in kendra or Mars exalted/own/moolatrikona
T2.sinic: 七杀/破军/贪狼 in Ming palace (both schools) OR Seven Killings/Rob Wealth as a visible stem

T3.jyotisha: Moon in kendra or Moon exalted/own/moolatrikona
T3.sinic: 天同/太阴/天梁 in Ming palace (both schools) OR Resource as a visible stem

T4.jyotisha: Mercury in own/exalted/moolatrikona sign and not combust
T4.western: Mercury in domicile/exaltation and free of beams
T4.sinic: 天机 in Ming (both schools) OR Eating God/Hurting Officer as a visible stem

T5.sinic: 天机/贪狼 in Ming (both schools) OR Ming branch in 寅申巳亥 (both schools)

T6.jyotisha: Saturn in kendra or Saturn exalted/own/moolatrikona
T6.sinic: 天府/武曲/天梁 in Ming (both schools) OR Direct Officer as a visible stem
